integrity: An elementary Gram-semidefinite upper certificate and an exact trace-class lower witness are supplied; finite exact-arithmetic checks are supplemental rather than a replacement for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to radius-one star graph masks and endpoint S1/B/complete norms, not other trees, radii, or intermediate Schatten exponents; n=2 was previously known; historical formula priority uncertainty remains.
title: Exact endpoint norms of radius-one radial Schur projections on stars
